subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word.

The new syllabus of Final Semester of MBA is very __difficult__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (easy)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"difficult"** means something that is not easily or readily done; requiring much effort or skill to accomplish or understand. (कठिन)
 
 
• **Example: **The exam was so difficult that many students couldn't finish it on time.
 
 
 
• **"Easy" **refers to something that is not difficult; requiring little effort or skill. (आसान)
 
 
• **Example: **The task was so easy that I completed it in just a few minutes.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'difficult' **is **'easy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (easy)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Perplexing **(उलझन भरा): Completely baffling; very puzzling.
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were so perplexing that nobody could figure them out.
 
 
 
• **Rigid **(कठोर): Not flexible; stiff; not able to be changed or adapted.
 
 
• **Example: **The rules were so rigid that there was no room for creativity.
 
 
 
• **Problematical **(समस्या जनक): Constituting or presenting a problem or difficulty.
 
 
• **Example:** The new policy is problematical as it creates more issues than it solves.
